_howto: Named search areas for ./cc scout --region <key>. Each region replaces area.name / area.bboxes / area.centers in config/scout.json, and sets the state written onto every lead it finds. bbox order is [south, west, north, east]. Add a region rather than editing scout.json, so San Diego stays the default and nothing already collected is disturbed.

delaware.name: Wilmington & central Kent County, DE
delaware._note: Felton itself has roughly 1,300 people, so a bbox drawn around the town alone returns almost nothing. The second box is the Felton–Camden–Dover–Harrington corridor it actually trades in; the third reaches Milford. Wilmington is the first and by far the largest.

national.name: National sample — 10 metros outside California
national._note: Deliberately spread across time zones so there is always somewhere open. State comes off each listing's own address tags, not from here.
